▸ Learning Linear Equations

• Read the meaning of Linear Equations.
• Copy every worked example into your book.
• Then solve the Try this questions without looking.

• Write each step. Box the final answer.

• Step 1: …

Try this
• Invent 3 Linear Equations questions using Kenyan shillings, metres, or classroom counts.
• Solve all three and show working.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES

• Show working for one Linear Equations question.
• Check with a second method.
